title: A compact leaf with nontrivial holonomy
promptMarkdown: For the suspension $(t+1,y)\sim(t,2y)$ with horizontal foliation, compute the holonomy germ of the leaf $y=0$. Prove that no saturated neighbourhood of that leaf can be diffeomorphic as a foliation to the product of a circle with an interval of circle leaves. Explain which hypothesis of local Reeb stability is absent and why the global sphere-leaf theorem is also unavailable.
hintLadder: Follow the quotient identification in the specified direction.
Compare powers of the return map.
A conjugate of the identity is still the identity.

criteria.criterion: Correct return germ and infinite holonomy.
